title: Problem-Solving & Data Analysis
summary: Ratios, rates, percents and units; mean, median and spread; samples and conclusions; probability and two-way tables.
bigIdeas: A percent change is a multiplier: up $p\%$ is $\times (1 + \frac{p}{100})$.
